strongest_opponent_point: Trend-follower’s claim that residual hawkishness is still US 2Y continuation after the already-delivered, greater-than-90% priced 25bp hike: US 2Y is higher on every frozen horizon (4.76 as of 2026-09-18, +9bp 1d / +13bp 5d / +57bp 1m / +57bp 3m, ~99.8th–100th percentile 1y), so further US-only backup would cheapen CA-US_2Y from -140.0 and, in their synopsis, mark CAD lower via USDCAD.
holes_in_opposing_case: The only CAD-lower tag in this bundle is trend-follower, and it is unowned. They selected outright short US_2Y and called long USDCAD inferior because 3m USDCAD is still -1.25% with 1y z 0.80. CAD_DOWN is a synopsis overreach from a US duration trade they refused to express in USDCAD.

Dollar-king’s USD_UP is short AUDUSD, not long USDCAD. They set cad_view neutral and rejected long USDCAD because WTI at the 96th percentile and CA activity 53.2 / consumer 52.5 support CAD. The dedicated USD seat’s own USDCAD analysis is this seat’s CAD case, not trend-follower’s.

Rate-dove and perma-bear have cad_view not_relevant. Their USD_UP is a residual of long AU_2Y at a 99th-percentile yield. Australian housing/labor damage is why this seat already refused to chase ACGB; it is not evidence that CAD should fall versus USD.
Positioning-cynic is CAD higher and US rates higher. Their USD_UP is a US 2s10s steepener versus crowded AM 10Y length, not a CAD-lower claim. Treating them as a CAD opponent is false.

Trend-follower’s catalysts concede Canada headline CPI still 3.0% and BoC energy pass-through, then treat a wider CA-US gap as confirmation of US 2Y. That 140bp gap is already a 1y 3.77th / 5y 4.31st percentile reading after -17bp 1m / -15bp 5d. Extra US 2Y backup after a priced hike is the over-owned US leg, not proof the BoC can keep diverging easier.

The 2026-09-17 CA 2Y -8bp print is not CAD weakness. CA 2Y is still +31bp 1m and 97.8th percentile 1y; the 5y percentile is only 58.6 (z_5y 0.15). The spread cheapened because Canada lagged the Fed reset. That is underpriced Canadian hawk, not a CAD-down trend.

Catalyst-junkie, perma-bull, value-guy and cross-merchant expect CAD higher and are same-side on the CAD conflict. Mean-reverter is USD lower like this seat and wants to receive US 2Y, which is the US duration leg of short CA-US_2Y, not a USD-up attack.

revised_trade.structure: Short CA-US 2Y government-yield spread (short CA 2Y duration versus long US 2Y duration)
revised_trade.thesis: FACT: The Fed raised 25bp to 3.75-4.00% after rate futures were greater-than-90% priced for that hike; August CPI is described as keeping the tightening bias intact; US core PCE was +0.2% m/m with roughly 2.4% 1m/3m annualized and roughly 3.0% 6m annualized; US unemployment 4.1% unchanged, payrolls +162k, AHE +3.1% y/y; ISM Services 55.4. US 2Y is 4.76 (as of 2026-09-18), +57bp 1m, 99.8th percentile 1y / 88.0th percentile 5y. FACT: Canada August headline CPI held at 3.0% y/y while CPI-trim 1.9% and CPI-median 2.0% stayed near target; BoC minutes flag higher energy pass-through risk; CA real GDP +0.8% q/q versus revised +0.1% in Q1; CA activity score 53.2 and consumer 52.5; CA labor weaker (unemployment 6.4% unchanged, employment -42k, average hourly wages +2.0% y/y versus +2.8%). CA 2Y is 3.27 (as of 2026-09-17), +31bp 1m, 97.8th percentile 1y but only 58.6th percentile 5y. FACT: CA-US_2Y is -140.0 bps as of 2026-09-17, 1y percentile 3.77, 5y percentile 4.31, z_1y -1.84, z_5y -1.51, 1m change -17bp. FACT: Australian 2Y/5Y/10Y yields are all ~99th percentile 1y and 5y while NSW stamp-duty receipts fell 24% y/y and Sydney/Melbourne values are down more than 7% from peak. NZ official yields are unavailable. INFERENCE: Markets have priced a large BoC-Fed divergence that Canadian headline inflation, activity, and the BoC’s own energy-pass-through warning do not justify; the hawkish US impulse is already in US 2Y, so the residual underpriced hawk is Canadian front-end catch-up, not another unpriced US 25bp. The CA 2Y 5y percentile of 58.6 shows Canada has not matched the global higher-for-longer reset on a longer window. AU is the opposite: hawkish pricing is already extreme and the housing channel is biting, so this seat does not short ACGB. UNKNOWN: the full post-hike OIS/hike-path (only the greater-than-90% 25bp probability is in the packet); CA 2Y on 2026-09-18 so the RV mark may not include the latest US 2Y +9bp day; whether energy pass-through actually shows up in Canadian CPI given the Saudi Oman workaround that reduced the extreme oil-supply tail; CME FX positioning.
revised_trade.mispricing: CA-US 2Y at -140.0 bps is in the bottom ~4th percentile of both 1y and 5y history (z_1y -1.84, z_5y -1.51) after a further -17bp 1m widening. That spread prices a BoC path far easier than a Fed that just hiked with core PCE still ~3% 6m annualized. Canadian headline CPI still 3.0%, GDP +0.8% q/q, and BoC minutes on energy pass-through are not consistent with that gap. The mispricing is the cross-market 2Y differential, not the absolute US 2Y level (already 99.8th percentile 1y after a pre-priced hike).

attack: The CAD conflict is 1-versus-many and the 1 does not own CAD. Only trend-follower marked CAD lower; they simultaneously refused long USDCAD because the 3m spot tape is still down while US 2Y is up on every horizon. A CAD-lower view that cannot survive its own expression comparison is not a reason to abandon Canadian hawk catch-up.

USD_UP from short AUDUSD or long AU_2Y does not reprice CA-US_2Y. Broad dollar strength versus AUD can coexist with CAD catch-up versus USD. Dollar-king even used CA activity/consumer and WTI richness to reject the USDCAD expression of USD_UP.

Paying US 2Y at executable_marks 4.76 is the inferior hawk. The 25bp hike was greater-than-90% priced; US 2Y is already a 1y extreme (+57bp 1m). Residual underpriced hawk is CA 2Y at 3.27, only 58.6th percentile on 5y, 140bp through the US. Short CA-US_2Y owns that residual; outright short US_2Y double-counts a priced Fed move.

Long USDCAD would pay the 140bp US-CA 2Y differential this RV already receives as carry and would mix oil-supply news the packet splits. USDCAD 1.4010471204188482 is 74th percentile 1y / 87th 5y — not the ~4th-percentile discrepancy.
